track: 28.04 HR END-TO-END CERTIFICATION — Frontend device-rendering walk
summary: Completed frontend device-rendering walk across HR portal at desktop (1920x800), tablet (768x1024), and mobile (390x844) viewports. HR login, hub, employees roster (558 rows, KPIs match), field-leadership records (19 rows), time-verification (all 4 filters + Export CSV/Print), training records, safety records, employee profile deep-link (accountability timeline), and permission gate all rendered correctly. No TEST_28_04_*, SMOKE_, SYNTHETIC_, CERT_TEST_, or PARITY_ leaks detected on any of the target HR list pages. One minor synthetic-filter leak observed on HR Hub 'Compliance At Risk' widget (TEST_iter151_* rows).

defects_found.surface: HR Hub /hr — 'Compliance At Risk' attention feed
defects_found.issue: TEST_iter151_DL_Past and TEST_iter151_scan_expired rows leak into the Compliance At Risk queue on HR Hub. These start with the TEST_ prefix that /app/backend/lib/synthetic_hr_filter.py is supposed to exclude, so the filter is either not wired to this particular attention-feed endpoint, or the Compliance At Risk feed uses a different data source (e.g., driver-qualification queue) that bypasses synthetic_hr_filter.
defects_found.impact: Cosmetic — these are TEST_iter151_* rows, not TEST_28_04_* rows, so Track 28.04 acceptance criteria (no TEST_28_04_* leaks) still passes. However the synthetic HR filter contract is violated: TEST_ prefix should be filtered everywhere HR-visible.
defects_found.recommendation: Wire synthetic_hr_filter into the /api/hr/... endpoint powering HR Hub Compliance At Risk (likely a driver-qualification-expiring endpoint) so TEST_/ITER prefixes are excluded consistently.

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend HR router at /app/frontend/src/app/routing/AppRoutes.jsx defines routes /hr/field-leadership (not /hr/field-leadership-records as review_request expected). Tile route correctly maps to it. No code change needed but PRD should reflect actual path.

Employee profile deep-link works via /hr/employees/<uuid>/accountability (EmployeeAccountabilityTimeline). The alternate deep-link pattern /hr/employees?id=<uuid> mentioned in the review_request is NOT wired — no query-string handler in HrEmployees.jsx. Consider adding ?id= deep-link support for symmetry with linked-from-external systems.

'Tenure' text not literally rendered on profile page (uses Trade/Crew/Supervisor + status chip instead). If 'tenure' is a Track 28.04 must-have surface, add a tenure/hire-date field to accountability header.
Console: single 401 error observed during unauthenticated /hr navigation — expected behavior (API returns 401, UI catches and shows sign-in interstitial). Not a defect.
test_credentials_used: hrmanager@mascigc.com / HRTesting2026! (HR portal) — valid, redirects /hr/login → /hr on success.
action_items: MINOR: Extend synthetic_hr_filter to cover the HR Hub Compliance At Risk / driver-qualification-attention feed so TEST_iter*, TEST_28_04_*, etc. are filtered consistently across ALL HR-visible surfaces (not just the pages already certified).
OPTIONAL: Add /hr/employees?id=<uuid> deep-link support in HrEmployees.jsx if external systems link into employee profiles by query-string.
OPTIONAL: Add tenure/hire-date to Employee accountability header if Track 28.04 lifecycle spec requires it (currently shows status chip only).

success_rate.frontend: 13/13 workflows pass; 1 minor synthetic-filter leak on Hub attention feed

Zero TEST_28_04_* / SMOKE_ / SYNTHETIC_ / CERT_TEST_ / PARITY_ leaks on Employees, Field Leadership, Training Records, or Safety Records lists. Permission gate correctly redirects to /hr/login.
